_about: Which /api/ calls the interactive demo answers (design D4, D9). 'record': GETs the recorder asks besides the pages' own, each template filled from the named lists. 'patterns': recorded answers reused for calls that differ only in the named parameters. 'handlers': calls the demo simulates (demo.js). 'not_in_demo': calls the demo refuses, with the reason the visitor sees. 'never_record': GETs the recorder must not keep.

not_in_demo.POST /api/reporting/{checklist}/{no}/tex: Saving reporting text is not part of the demo. In WIDER it writes your text for the item into the project's reporting folder, listed in History (wider report prisma edit|na|clear).
not_in_demo.POST /api/reporting/{checklist}/{no}/na: Saving reporting text is not part of the demo. In WIDER it writes your text for the item into the project's reporting folder, listed in History (wider report prisma edit|na|clear).
not_in_demo.POST /api/reporting/{checklist}/{no}/cle: Saving reporting text is not part of the demo. In WIDER it writes your text for the item into the project's reporting folder, listed in History (wider report prisma edit|na|clear).
not_in_demo.POST /api/reporting/flow: Saving flow counts is not part of the demo. In WIDER it writes the counts WIDER does not record, listed in History (wider report prisma flow --count NAME=N).
not_in_demo.POST /api/reporting/flow/clear: Saving flow counts is not part of the demo. In WIDER it writes the counts WIDER does not record, listed in History (wider report prisma flow --count NAME=N).
not_in_demo.POST /api/reporting/export: This export is not part of the demo. In WIDER it writes the PRISMA checklists, the methods text and the editable flow diagram into your project folder (wider report prisma export).
not_in_demo.DELETE /api/assistant/history: In the demo Ask WIDER answers only its example questions, recorded beforehand; it stays offline. In WIDER this is part of asking your own questions (wider assistant).
not_in_demo.POST /api/assistant/unhelpful: In the demo Ask WIDER answers only its example questions, recorded beforehand; it stays offline. In WIDER this is part of asking your own questions (wider assistant).
not_in_demo.GET /api/assistant/budget: In the demo Ask WIDER answers only its example questions, recorded beforehand; it stays offline. In WIDER this is part of asking your own questions (wider assistant).
not_in_demo.POST /api/assistant/budget: In the demo Ask WIDER answers only its example questions, recorded beforehand; it stays offline. In WIDER this is part of asking your own questions (wider assistant).
not_in_demo.POST /api/import/sources/{source_id}/sam: Marking an imported file as a random sample is not part of the demo. In WIDER it scales the diagnosis and the suggested edits to estimates (wider import sample FILE --of N).
